noiseSource: Preserved original CloudGenerator GPU output; shared Resources Texture3D RGBAHalf with original mip levels.
fallbackPrecisionPolicy: Strict fallbackExact/contractsPassed/passed are unchanged. A separate numerical result measures every fallback pixel. Each RGB and lighting-alpha channel must round-trip through a finite float16 encoding and differ by at most one adjacent value (signed ordering for RGB; alpha nonnegative). T and threshold hit must remain exactly equal. Mean error <=16 float32 ULP(reference mean), variance error <=16 ULP(reference mean squared), evaluated per pixel. No global metre/RGB tolerance is substituted. The largest absolute differences, encoding-step counts, out-of-budget pixel counts and local-budget maxima are recorded. This extra diagnostic budget does not turn a strict failure into a strict pass.
notes: Diagnostic GPU reads, not performance timings. Exact fallback means every color/T/depth/moment channel is bit-value equal. Surface color budget: mean RGB <=0.005 and P95 <=0.02. Successful mean-depth rounding bound is 16 float32 ULP; variance cancellation bound is 16 ULP of mean^2. Successful lighting alpha must round-trip through float16 and differ by at most one adjacent finite nonnegative float16 encoding per pixel, not a fixed metre threshold. T must be exactly zero for both successful outputs after the existing T<=.008 opaque stop; threshold hit remains exact. Finite outputs and real non-null RGFloat moment buffers are required. Strict differences are always recorded. Temporal is cleared before each compared frame to expose actual RGFloat depth moments. Weather/wind tests set interruption/reversal input sequences; the full weather controller transition test remains separate. Any zero accepted/emitted result fails completion even if every fallback image is exact.
